summary.text: Sara Gelser Blouin is a Democratic state senator from Oregon Senate District 8 who has served since January 2015, previously served in the Oregon House from 2005 to 2015, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Sara Gelser Blouin earned a bachelor's degree in history and education from Earlham College in 1994 and an M.A. in interdisciplinary studies from Oregon State University in 1999.

Her professional experience includes working as a regional coordinator for the Oregon Parent Training and Information Center, a policy analyst for the Oregon Department of Human Services, and a parent educator for Linn-Benton Community College.
She also founded the FG Syndrome Family Alliance and served on the Corvallis School Board from 2001 to 2006.
Gelser Blouin represented Oregon House District 16 from 2005 to 2015, and then succeeded Betsy Close in the Senate, assuming office on January 12, 2015.

In the 2023-2024 session, she chaired the Human Services, Mental Health and Recovery Committee and served on the Senate Education, Judiciary and Ballot Measure 110 Implementation, and Joint Ways and Means committees.
